About this model

Vegetation regrows toward a capacity of 100; rabbits eat vegetation and grow when food is sufficient; foxes eat rabbits and grow when prey is sufficient. Both scenarios start with plants 70 and rabbits 22. Baseline starts with 8 foxes; removal sets foxes to 0 at month 0. All other rules are identical.

Rates per month: dV/dt = 0.28V(1 − V/100) − 0.0036RV; dR/dt = R(0.0028V − 0.075 − 0.014F); dF/dt = F(0.0045R − 0.10). Fixed step: 0.03 month. Values are clamped at zero; V is capped at 100.

A simplified teaching model, not a forecast of a real ecosystem.

Outcomes depend on these assumptions and the 18-month timescale.
